description: A measurement established by a device which is tested to a calibration standard of known accuracy.

identifier.description: The identifier for this calibrated measurement.

quantificationTypeCode.description: The code specifying a quantification type for this calibrated measurement, such as measured, calculated, or estimated.

toleranceMeasure.description: The measure of the tolerance of this calibrated measurement.

tolerancePercent.description: The percent of tolerance of this calibrated measurement.

typeCode.description: A code specifying a type of calibrated measurement.

valueCode.description: The code specifying a value for this calibrated measurement.

valueMeasure.description: The value of a measure for this calibrated measurement.

versionId.description: The identifier of a version of this calibrated measurement.
